title: Classic German Sausage Stew
description: A hearty, comforting stew filled with the flavors of Germany. Perfect for a chilly evening.

ingredients.name: Lovely German Sausage
ingredients.notes: any type of German sausage, such as knockwurst or bratwurst

ingredients.name: Dense German Bread
ingredients.notes: such as pumpernickel or dark rye

instructions: Brown the sausage in a large pot over medium-high heat, about 5 minutes.
Remove the sausage from the pot and set aside.
Reduce heat to medium and add the chopped onion to the pot. Cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the chopped carrot and potato to the pot and cook for 5 more minutes.
Add the diced tomato, beef broth, and beer (if using) to the pot. Stir to combine.
Return the sausage to the pot and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Reduce heat to low and let the stew cook, covered, for 20-25 minutes, or until the vegetables are tender.
Season the stew with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley if desired.
